parameters.query: SELECT b.id::text as booking_id, b.customer_phone as phone, b.customer_name, s.name as service_name, b.start_time, wt.phone_number_id, t.name as tenant_name FROM bookings b JOIN tenants t ON t.id = b.tenant_id JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.customer_phone IS NOT NULL AND b.created_at >= NOW() - interval '10 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm WHERE wm.numero = b.customer_phone AND wm.metadata->>'booking_id' = b.id::text AND wm.metadata->>'reminder_type' = 'confirmacion') LIMIT 20

SELECT b.id::text as booking_id, b.customer_phone as phone, b.customer_name, s.name as service_name, b.start_time, wt.phone_number_id, t.name as tenant_name FROM bookings b JOIN tenants t ON t.id = b.tenant_id JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.customer_phone IS NOT NULL AND b.start_time BETWEEN NOW() + interval '23 hours 55 minutes' AND NOW() + interval '24 hours 5 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm WHERE wm.numero = b.customer_phone AND wm.metadata->>'booking_id' = b.id::text AND wm.metadata->>'reminder_type' = '24h') LIMIT 20

SELECT b.id::text as booking_id, b.customer_phone as phone, b.customer_name, s.name as service_name, b.start_time, wt.phone_number_id, t.name as tenant_name FROM bookings b JOIN tenants t ON t.id = b.tenant_id JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.customer_phone IS NOT NULL AND b.start_time BETWEEN NOW() + interval '55 minutes' AND NOW() + interval '65 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm WHERE wm.numero = b.customer_phone AND wm.metadata->>'booking_id' = b.id::text AND wm.metadata->>'reminder_type' = '1h') LIMIT 20

SELECT t.slug as tenant_slug, t.name as tenant_name, wt.admin_phone as phone, wt.phone_number_id, COUNT(b.id)::text as total_citas, json_agg(json_build_object('hora', TO_CHAR(b.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City', 'HH12:MI AM'), 'cliente', COALESCE(b.customer_name, b.customer_phone), 'servicio', COALESCE(s.name, 'Servicio')) ORDER BY b.start_time) as citas FROM tenants t JOIN wa_tenant_config wt ON wt.tenant_slug = t.slug JOIN bookings b ON b.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE b.status = 'confirmed' AND b.customer_phone IS NOT NULL AND DATE(b.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') = CURRENT_DATE AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') = 8 AND EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City') BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND wt.admin_phone IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_messages wm WHERE wm.numero = wt.admin_phone AND wm.metadata->>'reminder_type' = 'admin_daily' AND DATE(wm.created_at) = CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY t.slug, t.name, wt.admin_phone, wt.phone_number_id LIMIT 10
